originality.rationale: Vega proves the wheel nonequivariant sphere homotopy type; the complete oriented D_n character and mod-twelve fixed-space criterion are not in its inspected full text. The full scientific proof of the closest published cycle-matching equivariant result was inspected: it treats only the rim cycles and never counts hub spokes. The full wheel discrete-Morse equivariant result concerns a different complex of directed incidences, with different homology ranks. Implication comparisons and residual unindexed risks are recorded.
residual_risks: Equivalent work on equivariant wheel ordinary matching complexes, perhaps in unindexed or inaccessible literature, cannot be excluded.

value.rationale: Canonical wheel graphs have a previously known nonzero matching-homology wedge, but the group action and symmetry-quotient invariant are not given by ranks. This result supplies the complete rational D_n character, universal reflection-type coincidence, and a sharp mod-twelve quotient-homology vanishing theorem across an infinite natural family.
